title: Full graph-wide direct and finite-field elliptic index-calculus measurements
status_note: Design costed 2026-10-18 (PROTOCOL.md DRAFT, not frozen): 24,823 vertices x 12 arms x 8 targets x 5 rounds = 11,915,040 measured records in 256 resumable shards. Sizing probes: Plan A ~14,700 core-h (97% on the 45-bit three class), Plan B ~3,600 core-h; peak RAM <=0.35 GB/slot; disk ~119 GB. Bounded survey checkpoint: 2,935 vertices, all 51 strata (30,270 verified, 14,626 exhausted, 2,064 timeouts, all from the 3 s watchdog on three). Blocked on driver/ecbench code gaps G1-G8 and decisions D1-D3 (rounds on three, baseline arm, representation registration); finite-field IC for the actual embedding degrees stays unsupported.
blocked_on: note:code gaps G1-G8 in PROTOCOL.md section 11 (full-mode gate, shard selection, --cpus/--lock passthrough, registration, split rounds, native analysis, shard verifier, resume convention)
note:owner decisions D1-D3 in PROTOCOL.md section 9
question: How do complete cold index-calculus costs and relation yields vary across every vertex and conductor stratum, on exact matched subgroup targets?
decision_value: The full coverage ledger will distinguish variation by model and conductor from missing or censored runs, determine whether a factor-base or oracle change improves the verified IC baseline, and identify implementation limits of finite-field routes without inferring results for unrun vertices.

resources.notes: Derived from L0 sizing probes (PROTOCOL.md section 10; README cost table). Whole campaign on one host: 32 single-threaded shard slots. Plan A (registered) 14,728 core-h: two 197 + three 14,268 + mixed 263; wall 460 h ideal, 736 h if SMT yields ~20 effective threads, 920 h on 16 slots. Plan B (decision D1) 3,580 core-h, 112-224 h. Peak RAM <=0.35 GB per slot (bsgs on three 171 MB). Disk ~100 GB raw sessions + 6.5 GB binary copies + ~12 GB archives = ~119 GB (110 GiB); 128 GiB fits with ~16% headroom, 160 GB recorded for 30%. Per shard (1/256): ~57.5 core-h (A) or ~14 (B), ~0.43 GB. Code commit is the probe source; repin to a merged commit after G1-G8 land.

params.argv_note: Shard k = {shard} = {seed_lo} holds the vertices whose global queue ordinal is k mod 256 (PROTOCOL.md section 3). Pre-step, once per shard, from the repository root: target/release/volcano-ic-driver plan {out}/campaign <inputs> target/release/ecbench full freeze, which needs the shard selector of gap G2 (today plan takes the whole queue) and run refuses mode full until gap G1. run args are positional: CAMPAIGN MAX_JOBS MAX_SECONDS MAX_BYTES (driver.rs main). Slot pinning is taskset -c <slot>; the driver must pass --cpus none and a per-shard --lock (gap G3). After the shard finishes: pack per AGENTS.md section 13a and push off-host before the slot takes the next shard.

outputs.result_schema: Per shard: sealed ecbench.record/v1 sessions (one per vertex, 576 records), ecbench audit receipts, volcano-exhaustion-replay/v1 receipts, ledger.sqlite; aggregated with volcano-ic-summarize (summary v2) plus the native analysis of gap G6

cairn.notes: Not published, leased or scheduled. The separate bounded survey is real local execution and does not imply this card launched. run.argv is the real driver CLI; it refuses mode full until gap G1 lands, and per-shard planning needs gap G2. resume_flag is null because the driver resumes by re-invoking the identical argv (gap G8). outputs.verify needs a per-shard verifier binary (gap G7).

env.name: crypto-full-volcano-graphwide-ic
env.recipe: Linux image built at code.commit (repinned after gaps G1-G8 land) with the code.build command; the driver needs Unix flock/signals and git in the working tree (plan records git rev-parse HEAD and git diff). Inputs: the three certified *-workloads.jsonl files (sha256 in evidence/inventory.json) from the study Drive archive.

funding.rationale: Costed draft (Plan A ~14,700 core-h, Plan B ~3,600 core-h) but not runnable until gaps G1-G8 land and D1-D3 are decided; a reviewer sets funding against the 131072-1000000 seed-card range then.
